metadata.description: Texas cities organized by tier for programmatic SEO
sources: U.S. Census Bureau Vintage 2024 Population Estimates

tier_1_major_metros.notes: 4th largest US city. Texas Medical Center is world's largest medical complex. Major port city.
Joint Base San Antonio supports ~80,000 military/civilian. Major tourism (Alamo, River Walk).
Major financial hub. 17.3% workforce in business services cluster.
Silicon Hills. Tesla HQ. On track to pass 1M population. Major university town (UT Austin).
Crossed 1M threshold in 2024. Bell Textron HQ. Lockheed Martin F-35 production.
Fort Bliss supports 40,000+ military/civilians. Major US-Mexico trade corridor.

tier_2_midsize_cities.notes: Major deepwater port. Refining and petrochemical corridor.
Hub City. World's largest contiguous cotton-growing region. Texas Tech University.
Largest inland port on US-Mexico border. #1 industry is transportation/warehousing.
Processes ~25% of US beef supply. Pantex is only US nuclear weapons assembly facility.
Southernmost city in Texas. SpaceX Starbase nearby. International trade hub.
Adjacent to Fort Cavazos (formerly Fort Hood), one of largest US military installations.
Retail hub for South Texas and northern Mexico. 30-40% retail from Mexican shoppers.
Corporate center of Permian Basin oil industry. White-collar energy hub.
Baylor University. Magnolia Market tourism. Growing manufacturing base.
Spindletop birthplace of modern oil industry. ExxonMobil refinery is largest private employer.
Dyess Air Force Base. Three private universities. Regional healthcare hub.
Blue-collar counterpart to Midland. Industrial/field operations center for Permian Basin.
Largest city in East Texas. Major regional medical center. Rose Capital of America.

North Texas.description: Dallas-Fort Worth metroplex and surrounding areas north to Oklahoma border

Central Texas.description: Austin area, Waco, Temple/Killeen corridor, Bryan/College Station

East Texas.description: Piney Woods region from Tyler/Longview east to Louisiana border and south to Beaumont

West Texas.description: Permian Basin, Trans-Pecos, and surrounding areas

Gulf Coast.description: Houston area, Beaumont/Port Arthur, and coastal cities south to Corpus Christi

South Texas.description: San Antonio area south and west, border region excluding RGV

Rio Grande Valley.description: Southernmost tip of Texas along the Rio Grande, Cameron/Hidalgo/Starr/Willacy counties

Panhandle.description: Northernmost 26 counties of Texas, High Plains

Hill Country.description: Edwards Plateau region between San Antonio and Austin extending west
